title: Beverning and Vande Perre to Boreel, Westminster, 22 Aug/1 Sept 1653 (Thurloe State Papers i.435; cryptiana unsolved item #9 a)

steps.what: Extracted piece (a) from Birch's Thurloe State Papers on British History Online.

Applied every 1653-60 royalist and Commonwealth key from cryptiana (Marshall, Barwick-Hyde, Stamford, Butler, Charles II intercepted 1655, Kingston, Westrope, Hague agent/Blake) to piece (a) with apply_keys.py, scored by quadgram models: nothing readable.
Hill-climb on (a) with Dutch and French quadgram LMs, bijective and homophonic, 8 restarts: best -4.71 per quad, Dutch-looking fragments only.
(a) as a plain alphabetical key on 10-33 with any rotation or reversal.

Matched control for solve_a2.py on (a) (control.py, control_out.txt): synthetic texts in (a)'s exact layout (66+47+15 = 128 letters, 8 code groups), held-out Dutch/French/period-English text, 40 trials per cell, solver code unchanged. Recovered (>= 80% of letters): simple substitution 39/40 nl, 40/40 fr, 36/40 en; 25-symbol homophonic (homo, LAM 0.5, MAXH 2) 26/40 nl, 24/40 fr, 17/40 en. (a)'s own best (-4.71 nl, -4.57 fr per quad) lies below all 40 Dutch and all 40 French homophonic controls, so the negative is meaningful: (a) is long enough, and is not a <=2-homophone letter cipher of Dutch/French text as modelled.

Split under the one-key rule: pieces (b), (c), (d), each in its own cipher, moved to dugard1656, copinger1656 and waddall1656 with their ciphertext files; this entry keeps piece (a) (Beverning 1653). Shared scripts stay here.

outcome.method_basis: Every 1653-60 key on cryptiana fails on piece (a) and quadgram annealing does not read it; a matched control shows the text is long enough for the solver, so the system is not the one modelled.
outcome.notes: Originals in Bodleian Rawlinson A, not digitised; a deciphered sibling despatch would be in the Nationaal Archief (Staten-Generaal liassen Engeland), not online. Matched control run 2026-09-22 (control.py): the solver recovers synthetic texts of (a)'s layout (simple substitution 95-100%, 25-symbol homophonic 43-65% of trials), so the failure is meaningful, not a length artefact. Split on 14 Oct 2026: (b)-(d) are now dugard1656, copinger1656, waddall1656. The only commit (347fef4b5, 2026-09-15) has no model trailer.

gaps.detail: Matched control shows the length suffices for the solver, which still fails: system not the one modelled. Needs the key or a deciphered sibling despatch (Nationaal Archief), and Boreel's new code for the 8 code groups.

credits.note: Thurloe State Papers (1742): the only witness of the four intercepts

prior.where: Listed as undeciphered by Tomokiyo (cryptiana item #9); Birch's transcriptions are the only online witness and carry no decipherment.
